title: An adopted repository reports the pack records it lacks and one command refreshes every registered repository
body:
Why: Fable direction 1115e slice 1 (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-direction-1115e.md). Adopt copies applicable records into the repo; a repo adopted before the pack grew (43 to 62 records) misses records with no signal. Confirm first.
Outcome: krn doctor and adopt drift name the pack records an adopted repo lacks, exit non-zero with the remedy; one command refreshes every repo in the adopted registry.
Files: src/adopt/drift.ts, src/brain/adopted-registry.ts, src/brain/standards-cli.ts, src/cli/doctor-host.ts.
Proof: a fixture adopted on the pack minus 5 records reports 5 missing, and 0 after refresh. Free.
